title: Tech & Disruption
completion_message: ¡Fabuloso! El vocabulario de innovación y disrupción tecnológica es esencial para liderar en la era moderna. Palabras como 'Paradigm shift' o 'Bleeding edge' demuestran que estás a la vanguardia corporativa.

parts.visual:
1. Paradigm shift (Cambio de paradigma): 
- Un cambio fundamental en la forma de pensar o hacer las cosas. 
Ej: Artificial Intelligence represents a massive PARADIGM SHIFT in business. 

2. Disruptive innovation (Innovación disruptiva): 
- Una innovación que crea un nuevo mercado y desplaza a las empresas líderes existentes. 
Ej: Streaming services were a DISRUPTIVE INNOVATION for the movie industry. 

3. Bleeding edge (A la absoluta vanguardia): 
- Tecnología tan nueva que tiene un alto riesgo de fallar (más extremo que 'cutting-edge'). 
Ej: We invest in BLEEDING-EDGE software to stay ahead.
parts.audio: Welcome to Tech and Disruption vocabulary. Number 1: Paradigm shift. This means a fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions. For example: Artificial Intelligence represents a massive PARADIGM SHIFT in business. Number 2: Disruptive innovation. An innovation that creates a new market and completely displaces established leading firms. For example: Streaming services were a DISRUPTIVE INNOVATION for the movie industry. Number 3: Bleeding edge. This refers to technology that is so new and advanced that it has a high risk of being unreliable. It's more extreme than cutting-edge. For example: We invest in BLEEDING-EDGE software to stay ahead.

parts.visual:
4. Obsolete (Obsoleto): 
- Algo que ya no se usa porque ha sido reemplazado por algo más nuevo. 
Ej: Typewriters became OBSOLETE with the invention of computers. 

5. Scalability (Escalabilidad): 
- La capacidad de un sistema o empresa para crecer y manejar más demanda sin perder calidad. 
Ej: Cloud computing offers infinite SCALABILITY for startups. 

6. Pivot (Pivotar / Cambiar de dirección): 
- Cambiar radicalmente la estrategia de negocio manteniendo la visión central. 
Ej: The startup had to PIVOT from hardware to software to survive. 

7. Synergy (Sinergia): 
- La interacción o cooperación de dos organizaciones que produce un efecto mayor que la suma de sus partes (muy usado en fusiones).
parts.audio: Number 4: Obsolete. Something that is no longer produced or used, out of date. For example: Typewriters became OBSOLETE with the invention of computers. Number 5: Scalability. The capacity to be changed in size or scale, especially to handle growing amounts of work. For example: Cloud computing offers infinite SCALABILITY for startups. Number 6: Pivot. To fundamentally change the direction of a business when the current products aren't meeting the market needs. For example: The startup had to PIVOT from hardware to software to survive. Number 7: Synergy. The combined power of a group of things when they are working together that is greater than the total power achieved by each working separately.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término tecnológico y de innovación correcto.

questions.question: The invention of the internet was a massive ____ shift for the global economy. (Cambio de paradigma).
questions.explanation: Paradigm shift = cambio fundamental en cómo funciona algo.

questions.question: Uber was a highly ____ innovation that completely transformed the taxi industry.
questions.explanation: Disruptive innovation = innovación que rompe/cambia radicalmente un mercado establecido.

questions.question: This technology isn't just cutting-edge; it's ____-edge. It's so new that it still has some bugs.
questions.explanation: Bleeding edge = a la absoluta vanguardia (conllevando riesgo).

questions.question: Because of smartphones, traditional point-and-shoot cameras have become almost ____. (Obsoletas).
questions.explanation: Obsolete = desactualizado, ya no se usa.

questions.question: Investors love software companies because they offer infinite ____. It costs nothing to add a million new users.
When their main product failed, the startup had to ____ and focus entirely on enterprise software. (Cambiar de dirección / Pivotar).
questions.explanation: Pivot = cambiar radicalmente la estrategia de negocio.

questions.question: The merger was approved because of the massive ____ between the two companies. (1+1=3).
questions.explanation: Synergy = sinergia (cooperación que da un beneficio mayor que las partes separadas).

questions.question: A business model that removes the middleman and connects buyers directly with sellers is called ____.
questions.explanation: Disintermediation = eliminar a los intermediarios de la cadena de suministro.

questions.question: To stay competitive, the bank underwent a complete digital ____. (Transformación).
A system where all computers are connected to each other without a central server is a ____-to-____ network.
When a physical product is turned into a digital service, it is called ____.
A privately held startup company valued at over $1 billion is known as a ____.
questions.explanation: Unicorn = empresa emergente valorada en más de 1 billón (mil millones) de dólares.

questions.question: The process of using game design elements in non-game contexts is called ____.
questions.explanation: Gamification = ludificación (usar mecánicas de juego en apps/trabajo).

questions.question: We use machine learning ____ to analyze user behavior. (Algoritmos).
The interconnected network of everyday physical devices that can send and receive data is the Internet of ____.
A decentralized, distributed digital ledger used to record transactions across many computers is a ____.
A rapid, iterative approach to software development is known as ____ development.
The initial period of a startup where they are spending capital before generating revenue is the ____ rate.
questions.explanation: Burn rate = tasa de gasto de efectivo mensual.

questions.question: An early, basic version of a product used to test the market is an MVP, which stands for Minimum ____ Product.
questions.explanation: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) = Producto Mínimo Viable.

questions.question: Moving data and applications from local servers to internet-based servers is migrating to the ____.
A ____ shift. (Cambio de paradigma con P)
____ innovation. (Innovación disruptiva con D)
____ edge. (Vanguardia extrema con B)
The tech is ____. (Obsoleto con O)
Infinite ____. (Escalabilidad con S)
We had to ____. (Pivotar/Cambiar de dirección con P)
Corporate ____. (Sinergia con S)
A $1B startup is a ____. (Unicornio con U)
Minimum ____ Product. (Viable con V)
Migrate to the ____. (La nube con C)
